positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Adding features to code source in C# and JavaScript. Modifying existing code to increase maintainability. Remove knockout.js where it unnecessarily bloats the product and replaced it with more a maintainable MVC framework and cshtml files. Decreased memory footprint of the product running on client computers.

positions.title: Software Engineer and Database Designer
positions.description: Increased functionality in the old PHP/MySQL scripting system used for the call center. Built a new engine that generates scripts in C# and MSSQL.  The new engine not only has an entirely redesigned user interface, but also has a whole new approach to the script process, allowing for anyone to generate a script, and countless database analysis. Helped to build reports for the PHP/MySQL system, as well as expanded the functionality of the system in anticipation of the implementation of the new script generator. Increased the business' revenue by incorporating new designs into the system currently in use in addition to using my business knowledge learned through my minor. Applied bug fixing techniques to many errors generated by the current system.

company.name: Madison Avenue Media / Connect Point Research

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Maintained javascript, helping in development and the design of the look and feel of the application while working in an agile environment with a biweekly release cycle. Worked extensively with Microsoft's ASP.NET MVC framework in C# as well as knockout.js MVVM. Implemented a migration from knockout.js MVVM to a speedier jQuery HTML5 utilization for maximum application speed on more devices. Tweaked javascript code to increase apparent speed to the user through use of optimistic updating while waiting on AJAX responses from the server. Decreased both memory and cpu footprint of the application on target devices. Worked with bundling, minifying, and compressing files to minimize the applications footprint as much as possible.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Create, modify and develop websites in PHP, Java Script, and HTML.  Design, create, and modify databases in MySQL.  Build code libraries in PHP for encryption, database connection, and user management.  Coordinate with a team to create entire site designs including complete content management systems.  Update old sites for compatibility with new systems and new standards.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description: Performed applicant background checks for various clients.  Analyzed and identified criminal history and Motor Vehicle Record discrepancies.  Secured credit reports for additional verification.  Formated, installed, defragmented, and locked system configurations on all Verification Services network computers.  Created, recommended and implemented diverse ways to accelerate and organize the company database.  Repaired computer software, hardware, and network issues.

positions.title: Computer Consultant
positions.description: Provided professional direction and oversaw computer operations for a condominium association.  Resolved computer issues involving networks, processors, hard drives, printers, scanners, and random access memory (RAM).  Streamlined operations through the design and development of automatic defragmentation and the implementation of virus scanners and anti-spyware.  Established a domain and email server.
